We are using typescript 5.4.5 and react-instantsearch 7.11.3 and get exactly this error: 
```
<Configure hitsPerPage={5} />
```
```
Type '{ hitsPerPage: number; }' is not assignable to type 'IntrinsicAttributes & PlainSearchParameters'.
  Property 'hitsPerPage' does not exist on type 'IntrinsicAttributes & PlainSearchParameters'.
  ``` 
doesn't seem to be fixed?
